description: Source code for Odoo modules related to account fiscal positions and partner management, including classes for fiscal position mapping and partner financial details.

classes.name: account_fiscal_position
classes.description: Represents fiscal position configurations, including tax and account mappings.

classes.name: account_fiscal_position_tax
classes.description: Defines tax mappings for fiscal positions.

classes.name: account_fiscal_position_account
classes.description: Defines account mappings for fiscal positions.

classes.name: res_partner
classes.description: Extends partner model with financial properties and methods for receivables/payables.

methods.name: map_tax
methods.description: Maps source taxes to destination taxes based on fiscal position.

methods.name: map_account
methods.description: Maps source account to destination account based on fiscal position.

methods.name: _credit_debit_get
methods.description: Calculates total receivable and payable amounts for partners.

methods.name: _asset_difference_search
methods.description: Searches partners based on asset differences, such as receivables or payables.
